description: This file implements the PayPalRestPayment class, a payment module for integrating PayPal REST payments within the system. It includes methods for configuration validation, transaction initialization, authorization, and refund handling, with some stubbed or placeholder methods for future implementation.

classes.name: PayPalRestPayment
classes.description: Implements the PaymentModule interface to handle PayPal REST API payment processes, including configuration validation, transaction setup, authorization, and refund operations.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
